tagline: Quality outdoor power equipment, expert local service
heroSubheading: We stock the brands Te Awamutu trusts and service them right
aboutHtml:
Matthew and Sharlene have run STIHL SHOP Te Awamutu since 2013. We stock a wide range of quality outdoor power equipment from STIHL, Masport, Honda, Cub Cadet and other trusted brands, both online and in our Te Awamutu store.

Beyond sales, we specialise in expert servicing and repairs. We're known for Walker Ride-on Mowers, and we also offer hire services for short-term needs. Our team knows their gear inside out and gives friendly, straightforward advice you can trust.

We're proud to support the local community, backing the rugby grounds, bowling club, local golf courses, the Maungatari Trust and Fire Brigade. Come in and see us, Monday to Saturday.
servicesIntro: Our workshop provides professional servicing, repairs and hire for all your outdoor power equipment.
